title: Fundraising Event Ideas
content: Brainstorming session notes: Consider organizing a virtual marathon with a sign-up fee, hosting an online concert with local artists, or setting up a community art auction. Engage with local businesses for sponsorships and partnerships.

title: Donation Strategy Meeting Minutes
content: Meeting highlights: Emphasize recurring donations, enhance donor recognition programs, and utilize social media challenges to encourage youth participation. Avoid sharing specific donor amounts publicly to maintain privacy and trust.

title: Detailed Donor List
content: Confidential: Contains names, contact information, and donation amounts for donors from the last fiscal year. For internal use only. Ensure this information remains secure and is not shared outside of the organization.
